title: Anomalous Service Principal Secret Usage
body: Entra ID hunt for service principals authenticating from unexpected sources after secret rotation.

payload.title: Anomalous Service Principal Secret Usage
payload.description: Detects service principal sign-ins from IP ranges outside the organisation's normal footprint.
payload.author: viewer
payload.query:
ServicePrincipalSignInLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize count(), dcount(IPAddress), make_set(IPAddress, 10) by AppDisplayName, AppId
| where dcount_IPAddress >= 4
